name: ACA 452 偷渡犯 导航,自驾失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 452, you are at stand 203, from Wuhan to Tokyo, you just got informed an illegal stowaway on board, and he must be taken away by police, contact Wuhan Ground to delay the push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 452，在 203 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，刚得知机上有非法偷渡者，必须由警方带走，联系武汉地面请求延迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, stand 203, request delay the push back due an illegal stowaway must be taken away by police.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，203 号机位，由于一名非法偷渡者必须由警方带走，请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, report POB when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，准备推出和开车时报告机上人数。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell the Ground controller you are ready for push back and start up, POB 235.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在告诉地面管制员你准备推出和开车，机上人数 235。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, request push back and start up, POB235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，请求推出和开车，机上人数 235。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, tell the controller you will hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，告诉管制员你将原地等待，直到能见度好转。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, request hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，请求原地等待，直到能见度好转。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, the visibility now is 1000 meters, continue taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，现在能见度 1000 米，继续经滑行道 Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, 124.35, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，124.35，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 18R, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 18R 等待点，告诉塔台你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 452, holding point Runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 452，跑道 18R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, when airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff climbing, you encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, contact Wuhan Departure to turn right to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 起飞爬升期间，你遭遇前机尾流，联系 Wuhan Departure 请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 452, we encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 452，我们遭遇前机尾流，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, Wuhan Departure, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，Wuhan Departure，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: You are levelling at 10700 meters, your onboard navigation computers failed, you are flying with raw data, inform Wuhan Control the situation and request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正在 10700 米改平，机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，向武汉管制说明情况并请求雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, levelling at 10700 meters, our onboard navigation computers failed, we are flying with raw data, request radar vectors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，正在 10700 米改平，我们的机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 452, what's the situation like on board?
B: Tell the controller you need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 452，机上情况如何？
B: 告诉管制员你需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, we need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，我们需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, maintain present level, turn left heading 010, keep informed if you can't maintain RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，保持当前高度，左转航向 010，如不能保持 RVSM，请随时告知。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, turn left heading 010, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，左转航向 010，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: After finishing the checklist, the malfunction can't be solved and your autopilot failed, you are unable RVSM due equipment, inform Wuhan Control your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 完成检查单后，故障无法解决，自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM，向武汉管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, the malfunction can't be solved and our autopilot failed, unable RVSM due equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，故障无法解决，我们的自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 452, when able, advise your intention.
B: Tell the control you will maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 452，可以时报告意图。
B: 告诉管制你将保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, request maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，请求保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，收到，联系郑州管制119.35。
